parameters.name: FailedRuleTemplate
parameters.description: A filter for rules that failed the scoring.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The page size. Default: 10. Maximum: 100. Values less than 10 are set to 10, and values greater than 100 are set to 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. The service returns a token if the response is truncated. To retrieve the next page of results, include this token in your next request. If no token is returned, all results have been retrieved.

parameters.name: ResourceCategoryId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource category.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. For example, for an instance, this is the instance ID.

parameters.name: ResourceOwnerIds
parameters.description: A list of resource owner IDs. Use this parameter for cross-account scenarios. If you omit this parameter, the service returns data for the current account by default.
